lighting.description: The sun, sky, haze and grade (World Production Bible §12; the provisional look of 2026-10-05): a warm late-afternoon sun from the gameplay camera's upper left, so forms read and shadows fall toward the viewer.

massArt.description: What stands on each mass's top (ADR-073 §5), read by Game/Scripts/Crucible/BuildCrucibleMassArt.py: per kind, pieces on a jittered grid inset from the gameplay edge past where its face steps back, each a Tree, Shrub or Boulder by its share (the rest left bare), and on a forest shrubs round its rim. Nothing tall stands on rock, so nothing reaches the gameplay camera. Presentation only; the visual pass's values (2026-10-12).

massForms.description: How each kind of mass rises from its gameplay outline (ADR-073 §5), read by VeyraWorldTools' mass sculpt: its height above the highest floor along its edge, each mass its own within heightVariation, or above the floor beneath it where it drapes, as a low bank beside a sunken road must; its profile, pairs of [height share, share of insetMax] its face steps back by as it climbs, so cliffs keep ledges; broad bulges and vertical fissures breaking the face above walking height, only ever inward; the occlusion baked into its foot and fissures. The footprint at walking height is the gameplay edge. Presentation only; the visual pass's values (2026-10-12).

massLooks.description: Each mass kind's surface over the kit's mossy stone (M_CrucibleRock): bedded rock on its faces, moss on whatever faces up but only in broad patches (mossPatchFrom/To over the terrain's macro variation), so a cliff's top reads as rock with moss on it and never as the walkable floor; a forest's low bank is moss over earth, its face too. Presentation only.

keepLook.description: Each keep's architecture (ADR-073 §5): its walls stand over exactly the terrain that blocks there, a base course their full thickness, the wall above stepping in by the batter, a coping course standing out at the top above anyone's head, crenellated along it, with a capped pier at each bend closing the wedge its runs leave and a taller capped pillar flush with each wall's end beside a gate, in the kit's cut masonry. Presentation only; the wall heights are World.json's.

dressingProfile.description: Where the environment kit stands (VeyraDressingBuild.cpp): every placement decided by Veyra's rules, then turned half a turn for Team B. Presentation only; nothing here blocks or hides.
